hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: EXECUTION_PARAMETER
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: For multiple parameters, use '|' to separate the different parameters Ex: -h|-f --stock_symbol_list 0052.TW,006208.TW,00631L.TW,00692.TW,00850.TW,00881.TW,00981A.TW,00713.TW,00878.TW,00915.TW,00918.TW,00919.TW

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/bin/bash -e #set -eux #set -eu
cleanup() { # stop 後如果容器是 --rm 建立的 → 容器就會被自動刪除 docker stop "${CONTAINER_NAME}" echo "The container was deleted: ${CONTAINER_NAME}" } trap cleanup EXIT
LOCAL=Asia/Taipei DOCKER_COMMAND="-e TZ=${LOCAL} --rm -dit -v ${HOST_SRC_PATH}:/app --name ${CONTAINER_NAME}"
docker container rm -f ${CONTAINER_NAME} 2> /dev/null || true docker container run ${DOCKER_COMMAND} ${PYTHON_IMAGE_NAME} bash if [ "${NEED_FINMIND_TOKEN}" = "true" ] then if [ "${FINMIND_TOKEN}" = "" ] then echo "ERROR: Fin Mind Token Should NOT be empty" exit 1 fi fi echo "******************************************************************" now=$(TZ=$LOCAL date +"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") echo "${now}: Alpha Stack Analyzer Execution" IFS='|' read -r -a param_array <<< "${EXECUTION_PARAMETER}" tags="" for param in "${param_array[@]}" do if [ "${NEED_FINMIND_TOKEN}" = "true" ] then echo "Add Fin Mind Token into parameter list" param="${param} --finmind_token ${FINMIND_TOKEN}" fi echo "@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@" echo "Execute the '${param}' parameter" echo "@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@" docker container exec -i "${CONTAINER_NAME}" bash -c "python ./miscellaneous/alpha_stack_analyzer.py ${param}" echo "" done echo "******************************************************************"
